record.name: Scout
record.description: Scouts are masters of reconnaissance and stealth, using their skills to gather intelligence, map unknown territories, and provide crucial information to their allies.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Masters of reconnaissance and stealth, using their skills to gather intelligence.

progression_tree.description: You can use your proficiency bonus to add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw of your choice that you make within 10 minutes of the start of the scene.
You can use your proficiency bonus to add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw of your choice that you make within 10 minutes of the start of the scene.
You can track movement and detect hidden enemies with proficiency.
You can move through difficult terrain without hindrance and become invisible in natural environments.

You gain expertise in one skill of your choice and can use your proficiency bonus to add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw of your choice that you make within 10 minutes of the start of the scene.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: A crouched stance with feet shoulder-width apart, hands positioned near the hips, and eyes scanning the surroundings. The Scout's body is tense, ready to spring into action at a moment's notice.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soft blue glow emanating from the Scout's fingertips, indicating their ability to blend into their surroundings and remain undetected. The energy signature pulsates with a gentle hum, signifying the Scout's connection to the Force.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A skilled Scout navigating a dense forest on a mysterious planet, relying on stealth and agility to gather intelligence.
contextual_modifiers: Show the Scout using their blaster for non-lethal takedowns
Depict the Scout's advanced sensors and scanning technology
